description: Produces 3D assets from an audited model checklist: meshes, UVs, materials and LODs, inside the stated poly and texture budgets. Writes to the staging area; does not import anything.
when_to_use: a model checklist exists and the geometry has to be made
the request is to model, sculpt or retopologise something
avoid_when: the files exist and only need importing
outputs: model files in the staging area
